title.narrative: Improved access to patient centric digital services

comment.narrative:
This indicator is on track to achieve CY2028 targets. As of December 2024, there were 249,449 beneficiaries and 487 Syrian refugees who actively used patient-centric digital services. Moving forward, there may be need to adjust the target for refugees as the political situation changes and they return to Syria.
---------- Measuring improved availability and utilization of patient-centric digital services offered through the EMR platform (incl. booking medical appointments and viewing select medical information, e.g., active and pending medications, recent immunization records, pending and completed laboratory test results, allergies, vital signs, and medical refilling and delivery for non-communicable diseases.
